From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Multi-Prospect Plenum — calendar weave + host handoff

Hi Emma / Carlos —

Thanks for the interest in a joint session. A few BlueRiver and DataForge teams asked to consolidate office-hours-style demos into a single "plenum" to reduce repeated briefings. We think a single 60-minute session split into two focused blocks (product demo + ops/architecture) will be most efficient.

Proposal:
- 60 minutes total; 30m demo (Ben) + 25m ops/technical + 5m Q&A handoff (Soojin).
- We can run a single calendar invite and rotate hosts so each prospect gets a clear ops contact.
- Attached: plenum_agenda_v1.pdf and a light host-rotation template.

Can you share 3 windows that work for your teams next week (PT preferred)? If folks are in EST/EU we'll stitch timezones; I'm happy to run the host rotation.

If you prefer, we can provide a short pre-recorded fallback segment in case of platform constraints — Ben flagged that as an option.

Next steps: you share availability, we propose 2 candidate slots and a calendar poll.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: plenum_agenda_v1.pdf

Karthik —

Thanks for pulling this together. We think the two-block approach sounds ideal. BlueRiver attendees: myself, Michael Tan (platform), and our procurement lead (may be optional for this call). Our key asks: short latency/throughput demo, and an ops walkthrough covering data isolation and VPC options.

Availability from our side (PDT):
- Tue Jul 7: 10:00–11:00am PT
- Wed Jul 8: 1:00–2:00pm PT
- Fri Jul 10: 8:30–9:30am PT (early)

We can make Tue Jul 7 work if that fits everyone. If you need prep materials, please send — Michael would appreciate a short pre-read on model variants and quantization strategies.

Emma
